page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at top, with the printed page number at the top right. Line numbers in the left margin at every fifth line. Below the first paragraph, a four-column table of gemstone names (Vatablus, Iunius, Brugthonus, Danæus). Then the closing paragraph of the page. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the lower left.

main_text.p: turalis. Naturalis est partim in culinâ, partim in medicinâ: supernaturalis, in significando mysteria, vt quod nullum sacrificium debuit offerri sine sale Leuit. 2. v. 13. Marc. 9. v. 49. quod apostoli appellantur sal terrae. Matth. 5. verf. 13. 5 quod sermo nostrer debet esse conditus sale Coloss. 4. v. 6. quod denique debemus in nobis ipsis habere salem, ita vt igne saliamur. Marc. 9. v. 49. 50.

V. Lapidum vulgarium & pretiosorum mentio fit in sacris. Ex lapidibus vulgaribus frequenter fit 10 mentio lapidum, quorum vsus est in aedificiis: item petrae, silicis, marmoris & arenae. Ex lapidibus pretiosis celebrantur margaritae, & XII. gemmae Exod. 28. de quibus infra in Lithologia. Quia vero interpretes variant in reddendis nominibus Hebraicis istarum gemmarum, aliquot sententias breviter commemorabo.15

Hic solent quaerere, quid sit bdellium Gen. 2. verf. 12. 30 Resp. Alij volunt esse iaspidem: alij carbunculum: alij album quendam lapidem: alij arborem, quae Arabibus dicatur etiamnum hodie Bdolchon: alij denique margaritam praestantissimam. Cui postremae sententiae vt astipu-35 ler facit collatio huius loci Gen. 2. cum Exod. 16. v. 14. 15. & Num. 11. v. 7, vbi color mannae dicitur fuisse sicut color

page.notes: Printed "vsus", "aedificiis" and similar spellings are as set; long s is transcribed as s. Doubtful: the fourth-column entry "Hyacinthus" in the third column is hard to read and is marked [?]. The margin numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed line numbers. The small "vt quod" accent on quod is not clear and is written plain. The page number "83" is set in a stylised form. The running head is "BIBLICUS." with the page number at the right.
